component.text:
Sintaks Perintah Cisco IOS CLI
.
tunjukkan vlan [singkat | id vlan-id | namanama vlan | ringkasan].
Display one line for each VLAN with the VLAN name, status, and its ports. singkat
Display information about a single VLAN identified by VLAN ID number.
For vlan-id, the range is 1 to 4094. 		id vlan-id
Display information about a single VLAN identified by VLAN name. The VLAN name is an ASCII string from 1 to 32 characters. namanama vlan
Display VLAN summary information. ringkasan

Sintaks Perintah Cisco IOS CLI
.
tampilkan antarmuka[antarmuka-id | vlanvlan-id] | switchport
Valid interfaces include physical ports (including type, module, and port number) and port channels. The port-channel range is 1 to 6. antarmuka-id
VLAN identification. The range is 1 to 4094. vlanvlan-id
Display the administrative and operational status of a switching port, including port blocking and port protection settings. switchport

component.feedback: ***You must enter the exact and full command. Commands that include a name or password are case-sensitive.***
